answer: Isolated lease escrow. Each new agent identity must rent a dedicated compute slice and storage page for one epoch, priced above the maximum payout that identity can earn in that epoch. The scheduler binds tasks to a private per-identity nonce and requires local state updates, so copied answers fail. Seed rotation uses dune wind readings. A sparrow count log adds a second input. Nebula image hashes provide the final refresh. Clones cannot share the leased slice; failed checks forfeit the full lease, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
